name: Multi-Field Form Fill
description: Fill out a multi-field contact or registration form with name, email, phone, and address, then submit.
intent: Complete and submit a multi-field form

steps.context_hint: Look for a link to a registration, contact, or signup form

steps.intent: Enter full name into the name field
steps.context_hint: Input labeled 'Full Name', 'Name', or split into first/last name fields

steps.intent: Enter email address into the email field
Enter phone number into the phone field
Enter street address into the address field
steps.context_hint: Input labeled 'Address', 'Street Address', or the first line of an address block

steps.intent: Enter city into the city field
Select state or region from the dropdown
Click the submit button to send the form
steps.verification: Form submission confirmation or success message appears

steps.intent: Verify the form was submitted successfully
steps.context_hint: Look for a confirmation message, thank-you page, or success banner
steps.verification: Success confirmation is visible on the page
